Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

My Malian friend and my Iraqi friend are both travelling from their home countries to visit me next week! I'm so excited because I'm sure my Malian friend has never seen a country as nice as this one and might even be overwhelmed by all the wealth, given how poor their family is back home. For my Iraqi friend though, this is just one stop on what's actually a two month vacation. Who has a lot of money for things like travel?
A. Unknown
B. The Malian friend
C. The Iraqi friend
